name: Papa Jay's Pizzeria
tagline: Locally owned downtown Dover pizzeria since 2001: pizza, steak tip subs, fresh wings, delivery and catering.
seo_title: Papa Jay's Pizzeria | Pizza, Steak Tip Subs, Wings & Catering in Downtown Dover, NH
seo_desc: Papa Jay's Pizzeria, locally owned in downtown Dover NH since 2001. Hand-cut steak tip subs, fresh wings, 20-inch jumbo pizza, delivery to Dover, Somersworth, Madbury and Rollinsford, and catering. Call (603) 750-7272.

specialties.d: Fresh, not frozen, mixed in Sweet Baby Ray’s sauces. Bone-in or boneless.

letter: Papa Jay's Pizzeria is a locally owned restaurant that has been open since 2001. We focus on fast service and a quality product, and we have started to offer catering for special events and family gatherings. We offer delivery to Dover, Somersworth, Madbury, and Rollinsford and catering to many other surrounding towns. Unlike chain restaurants we are locally owned, and we use a local produce company, bread company, advertising company and food vendors that employ local people. Without our customers we would not be a successful restaurant. Thank you.
